checks.name: No goal is required; learner notes guide the same lesson request
Earlier suggestions and previously seen words are included without pretending they were spoken
I said this records a confirmed user turn without another model call
A new learner starts with isolated notes, history and conversation
Switching back restores only the first learner memory
Location is opt-in, coarse and not written into saved lessons
Switching learner stops sensor sharing and restores the other learner independently
Optional real AudioWorklet samples reach the lesson but never the history
Learner memory survives reload without mixing profiles
Deleting a phrase during a lesson request does not recreate it on completion
A distinctive spoken suggestion is automatically marked as likely learner speech
Model-inferred learner intent is remembered without requiring a goal
